description:
Recycling fee (утилизационный сбор) for a passenger car (category M1) imported into Russia.

    Uses the official coefficient table (Decree 1291 as amended by Decree 1713 of 01.11.2025):
    base rate 20 000 RUB x coefficient by engine type, volume, power band (kW), age and year
    (Dec 2025, 2026 ... 2030). Covers the commercial table and the personal-use table
    (0.17 / 0.26 for up to 160 hp and up to 3 l). Returns the coefficient, band and source.

eaeu_extra_rub.description: For cars released in another EAEU country: sum of Ктп + Кндс + Ка (duty, VAT, excise differences), if known
eaeu_extra_rub.title: Eaeu Extra Rub

engine.description: ice = petrol/diesel; hybrid_parallel counts as ICE; ev = electric; hybrid_series = series hybrid (counts as EV)
engine.title: Engine

engine_volume_cc.description: Engine displacement in cm3 (required for ice and hybrid_parallel)
engine_volume_cc.title: Engine Volume Cc

older_than_3_years.description: True if more than 3 years have passed since the production date
older_than_3_years.title: Older Than 3 Years

on_date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD the fee is calculated for; default today. Tables run Dec 2025 - 2030
on_date.title: On Date

personal_use.description: Imported by an individual for personal use (preferential 3 400 / 5 200 RUB up to 160 hp and 3 l)
personal_use.title: Personal Use

power_hp.description: Engine power in horsepower (л.с.); for EVs the 30-minute max power
power_hp.title: Power Hp

power_kw.description: Engine power in kW, alternative to power_hp
power_kw.title: Power Kw

name: calc_recycling_fee
